messages:
maria: opened a PR to tweak rate-limit/timeout behavior in py-sdk for streaming+rest clients. Tests added, but I adjusted the default batch window too; needs a perf sanity check and 1 approval before I merge today. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1234
aj: looking now, quick question — does this change the default backoff? I don't see it in the diff.
maria: no, backoff unchanged. I only adjusted the token-based rate window and added a flag `enable_stream_hedging`. tests: unit + integration for streaming harness.
kevin: @maria can you paste the config snippet? want to run a small local smoke test.
maria:
```
# client config
rate_limit:
  tokens_per_minute: 60000
  window_ms: 500
streaming:
  enable_stream_hedging: true
```
kevin: thx; will run it now.
ci-bot: CI pipeline passed — build 7892 (unit + lint + py37). :white_check_mark:
aj: ran basic smoke. latency looks ok but saw a small increase on long sequences ~50-60ms. Could be due to hedging; maybe add a conditional to only enable hedging for >512 tokens.
maria: good call, I'll gate it behind sequence length. I can push a tiny follow-up if reviewers are ok.
tim: I'll take an approval once the gate is added. :+1:
kevin: approved pending the gating change. :eyes:
maria: thanks all — aiming to merge EOD Fri unless anything else. ping @eng-platform if you want to stress test it in staging.
